Hello, Joice. I am Peter, your coordinator. Did you read the email?
Yes, I did. My partner is Marina, from Recife.
Very good. And what is her project about?

Good morning. Welcome to your first Fellowship meeting. My name is Peter Lang, and I am your group coordinator. In your group there are six people, from five countries. Your partner for the first month is Marina Alves, from Recife. Her project is about technology in small schools. Our meetings are on Tuesday. Please read your group's document before the call. Their questions are at the end of the page. Thank you, and welcome.

Hello, this is a message from the university. Our director sends her best wishes to the new group. The professor of the research program is Doctor Klein. His office is on the second floor, and his email is at the end of this message. Marina's report is ready, and it is in your group folder. If you need our team, please write to us. Our answer is always in two days. Thank you very much.

Joice opens the email from the Fellowship. She reads the name of her coordinator. She reads her partner's name and her project. She writes to Peter and says hello. She puts the meeting in her calendar.
